immutability_rule: This file is evidence, not configuration: no script under evaluation may modify it. Expected answers/evidence mappings change only by explicit human review.

sections.real_corpus: Cases grounded in the actual knowledge/books/ documents (text extracted read-only 2026-10-16).
sections.synthetic_fixtures: Cases grounded in clearly-labeled synthetic fixtures (benchmarks/rag_fixtures/, generated by scripts/make_rag_fixtures.py). Metrics for this section NEVER represent real-world corpus accuracy.

gap_list: No real multi-column documents in the corpus (only the synthetic columns fixture).
No real scanned/image-only pages in the corpus (only the synthetic scan fixture).
No real tables in the corpus (only the synthetic table fixtures).
No real multi-page tables, figures, charts, or captions in the corpus.
No Arabic-language cases (Q4=A: English-only initial baseline).
No genuine real-corpus cross-document questions beyond the single crafted comparison R011.
No footnotes/references sections in the corpus.
No documents larger than one 1024-token chunk: every corpus file and fixture fits in a single chunk under current chunking, so chunk-boundary behavior is NOT exercised by this gold set.
Answer-level metrics (citation correctness, unsupported-claim rate) are out of RAG-1 scope: they require chat-model calls, which are not authorized.
